product: APX ERP (often written or said as 'Apex'; sold as 'APX - ERP for Retail & Distribution')
vendor: APX Solution, Kodambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu (IndiaMART listings call the company Abstech Logiks / ABS Tech Logiks Pvt Ltd, but we could not open those pages)

facts.claim: APX calls itself an 'ERP for Retail & Distribution' that covers inventory, logistics, finance and multi-location management.

Its client list is mostly large mobile-phone retail chains, including Sangeetha Mobiles (700+ stores, Karnataka), Phonewale (500+, Gujarat), Poorvika Mobiles (450+, Tamil Nadu), Poojara Telecom (400+, Gujarat), Umiya Mobile (300+), Fonebox (250+), Bhatia Communication (250+), Girias (200+), Kore Mobiles (200+), B New Mobiles (150+) and Happi/Hello Mobiles (75+).

It also lists distributors (for example United Telelinks Bangalore) and a few non-mobile clients (Furniture World, Ramalinga Agro, Jitendra Wheels), plus overseas clients in Bahrain (Sky World Trading) and Tanzania (Simstel Connect).
The homepage claims '10,000+ installations spreading across various industries and geographical locations'.
A Poojara Telecom testimonial says it has used APX for about 20 years, that it was APX's second customer, and that it grew from 2 to 70 showrooms on it.
No prices are published. Every feature has a 'Get Price' enquiry button instead.
The site has a 'Get Free Trial' button. The length and terms of the trial are not stated.

Serial/IMEI tracking is built into the Inventory module ('barcode, Serial/IMEI numbers, stock locations, branch stock transfers') and the Purchase module ('Serial/IMEI number tracking'). It is not described as a paid add-on.
It has a 'Schemes, Targets & Incentives' module that 'includes schemes, achievements, claims, and credit note follow-ups'.
The Reports module covers salesperson achievements, and the Distribution module covers sales personnel performance.
It has a Service module that 'facilitates product service procedures, spares handling, and follow-ups'. The Sales module also mentions 'service tracking'. The site does not use the term 'job card'.
It supports stock locations, branch stock transfers, multiple-location delivery on purchases, and internal stock orders.
It is used by chains of 75 to 700+ stores, and a Phonewale testimonial describes running 500+ stores across multiple states on one integrated platform.
It offers 'various scenario-based price templates, discounts, formula-based pricing, seasonal pricing, and fluctuation tracking'. Per-branch pricing is not stated explicitly.
It 'handles government-stipulated e-invoice & e-way bills procedures and related reports'.

The Accounts module 'covers ledgers, vouchers, bank reconciliation, PDC, cash/bank books, and financial statements' plus direct bank payments. Reports include profits, ageing, collections and growth comparison.
The Sales module supports 'cash/credit/third-party finance billing, credit validations'. Reports include ageing and collections.

Listed finance partners are Bajaj Finserv, Cholamandalam Finance, HDB Finance, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, IDFC First and TVS Credit. Listed card/EDC and wallet partners are Razorpay, Pine Labs, Paytm, Bajaj Pay and PhonePe. Listed insurance partners are OneAssist and Onsitego.
The CRM module includes 'bulk mailers, bulk WhatsApp, customer follow-up process monitoring'. Sending individual bills on WhatsApp is not mentioned.
APX is described as the 'APX Web Application'. The APX-m Android app is a companion app, not a standalone product: 'Login requires a APX-API Base Url'.

APX-m lets users create purchase orders, sales orders, quotations, internal stock transfers and orders, approve discounts and POs, and view dashboard reports. It had 1K+ downloads and was last updated 1 Sept 2026. Billing from the app is not listed.
Microsoft Azure is listed as its cloud partner.
Job postings say development uses ASP.Net C#, MVC and MS SQL Server.
It has a proven track record at India's largest mobile retail chains, with many clients running 100 to 700+ stores, which suggests it scales to very large multi-state chains.

It is a full ERP: schemes, claims and credit notes, order processing with approvals, dealer/sub-dealer distribution, full accounts with bank reconciliation and PDC, e-invoice and e-way bill, audit tools and user rights.
It has partnerships with consumer-finance lenders (Bajaj Finserv, HDB, TVS Credit and others) and device-protection providers (OneAssist, Onsitego) that matter to phone retailers.
APX says it offers 'tailored implementations, responsive support', which suggests a customised, implementation-led sale rather than self-serve sign-up.

not_found: Any published price, plan names, billing basis (per store/user/year) or free plan
Warranty tracking or warranty claims with brands (only 'service' and 'claims' under schemes are mentioned)
Explicit consolidated multi-store reports or per-branch pricing (implied by the client base, but not stated)
GSTR-1/GSTR-3B return filing (only e-invoice and e-way bill are stated)
Balance sheet or P&L by name (only 'financial statements')
Sending individual bills/receipts or payment reminders on WhatsApp
Offline billing mode, desktop version, or iOS app
notes: IDENTIFICATION: The 'Apex' used by Indian mobile/electronics chains is almost certainly APX ERP by APX Solution, Chennai (apxsolution.in). Its client list (Sangeetha, Poorvika, Phonewale, Poojara, Umiya, Girias, Happi/Hello, B New, etc.) matches the mobile-retail industry exactly. People commonly say and spell 'APX' as 'Apex'; confirm the spelling with Ankit before publishing a page titled 'Apex'. UNVERIFIED: search-engine snippets from IndiaMART (https://www.indiamart.com/abs-tech-logiks/erp.html, https://www.indiamart.com/abs-tech-logiks/aboutus.html) say APX was 'brought out by ABSTech in the year 2000' and serves 'approximately three thousand customers across almost all Indian States'. IndiaMART returned 403, so we did not read these pages; do not publish those figures without checking. The vendor's own site says '10,000+ installations', which is a different metric. The About page gives no founding year. OTHER 'APEX' PRODUCTS (not relevant): Apex POS Android app (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apexlite.app&hl=en_IN; generic retail POS, English/Swahili, appears Africa-focused); Apex Software House, Bhavnagar (https://www.tradeindia.com/apex-software-house-10435969/); Apex Software Solutions, Cuddalore (https://www.tradeindia.com/apex-software-solutions-17698373/); Apex Infotech, Chennai, a billing-software dealer on Justdial; Oracle APEX (a low-code database tool, unrelated). None of these showed evidence of use by mobile chains. POSITIONING: APX is an enterprise, implementation-led ERP for chains and distributors with custom pricing. It is not a self-serve product for single stores, so a fair comparison page should say APX suits 100+ store chains that need deep distribution/accounting ERP.
